name: animated-form
title: Animated Form
description: Config-driven contact form with validation for text, phone, select, textarea, and checkbox fields

changelog.summary: Removed fields, submitLabel, successMessage, and validateOnBlur from the public/remixer API. The built-in form fields now always render, while color, border radius, and duration props customize the form controls.

Added submitLabel and successMessage as public props with a working remixer panel. fields is now also a real prop (previously hardcoded), but is left undocumented for the live panel since its default value embeds a JSX checkbox label (Terms link) that isn't JSON-editable. The originally suggested accentColor/validateOnBlur props don't exist anywhere in this form's field components, so they were dropped rather than shipping non-functional controls.

Phone validation now uses per-country national-number length ranges (with trunk-zero tolerance) instead of a flat 10-digit rule that rejected all valid numbers from Ireland, Australia, France, the UAE and Singapore.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: Accent color for focus states, checkbox checks, and the submit button.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Page background color around the form.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color for the form heading and field labels.

props.name: inputBackgroundColor
props.description: Background color for inputs, textarea, and select controls.

props.name: fieldBorderColor
props.description: Default border color for form controls.

props.name: inputRoundedness
props.description: Border radius for inputs and the submit button in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Transition duration for control focus and button effects in seconds.
